oracle: the same pinned OpenROAD power engine on the same routed design: (1) its own vectorless result must reproduce the number ORFS wrote in metadata for that run, which validates the setup independently of our scripts; (2) physical sanity from the workloads' construction (zero operands cannot switch more than random ones)

criteria.name: setup_reproduces_orfs_vectorless
criteria.threshold: our own vectorless report_power on the routed design (same Liberty/ODB/SDC/SPEF) within 1 % of ORFS finish__power__total of the same run

criteria.name: vcd_annotation_coverage
criteria.threshold: annotated fraction of netlist pins >= 0.90 for every workload (VCD names map onto the routed flat netlist)

criteria.name: workloads_valid
criteria.threshold: 0 mismatches vs NumPy per workload; operand zero fraction sparse50 in [0.48,0.52], allmax = 0, random < 0.01

criteria.name: allmax_uses_less_dynamic_power_than_random
criteria.threshold: additional expected ordering: constant all-max operands, dynamic power allmax < random

criteria.name: leakage_roughly_constant
criteria.threshold: (max-min)/mean of leakage over the three workloads <= 0.10

criteria.name: analysis_deterministic
criteria.threshold: second identical analysis of the random workload gives identical internal/switching/leakage/total

criteria.name: netlist_identity
criteria.threshold: sha256 of the netlist OpenROAD analysed equals the one the VCD simulation used (results/part1_snapshot/systolic_os_routed/6_final.v)

commands: scripts/t1_power_vcd.sh   # rtl: three fixed-seed VCDs of the routed netlist -> results/power_vcd/
scripts/p2_power_activity.sh   # OpenROAD read_vcd + report_power per workload, summary, plot
notes: OpenROAD commands: read_vcd [-scope s] [-begin_time t] [-end_time t] file, report_power (Liberty power models); VCD scope candidates TOP/systolic_os (Verilator) then systolic_os (Icarus); active-window run is primary, whole-file run is the fallback if the window run annotates < 50 % of pins or reports no dynamic power. Zero-delay gate-level VCD: no glitch power, so results are functional switching activity only. The clock is 4.0 ns (the base constraint), not the 1.25 ns sweep frontier.
